name: whoami
description: Returns the authenticated user's handle, email, all the plans the user belongs to (and the ID for each plan) and their seats on those plans. Each plan includes user_can_access_figma_ai, a boolean indicating whether the user has Figma AI permission and the plan admin has enabled AI features. You MUST use this tool if you are experiencing file access/permission issues or are being rate limited by the Figma MCP to help debug the issue.
